.github/workflows/ci.yml:sdks:Validate S.reason: Preserve SDK surface validation and retain pinned Java 25 Gradle and TypeScript identities.

steps.name: Install the checksum-pinned Java-compatible Gradle
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
version="$(python3 -c 'import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open("tools/toolchain.toml", "rb"))["sdk"]["gradle"])')"
checksum="$(python3 -c 'import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open("tools/toolchain.toml", "rb"))["sdk"]["gradle_sha256"])')"
destination="${RUNNER_TEMP}/lsf-gradle"
mkdir -p "$destination"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 180 \
  "https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-${version}-bin.zip" -o "$destination/gradle.zip"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$checksum" "$destination/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check --strict
unzip -q "$destination/gradle.zip" -d "$destination"
echo "$destination/gradle-${version}/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Qualify the Java 25 Gradle build
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk"
git rev-parse HEAD | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/gradle.log"
uname -srm | tee -a "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/gradle.log"
python3 sdk/java-client/tools/java_toolchain.py check | tee -a "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/gradle.log"
gradle --version | tee -a "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/gradle.log"
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_check_tool_versions tools.tests.test_java_toolchain 2>&1 | tee -a "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/gradle.log"
timeout 540 gradle --no-daemon --console=plain -p sdk/java-client clean check 2>&1 | tee -a "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/gradle.log"
echo 'Gradle qualification passed' | tee -a "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/gradle.log"

steps.name: Validate SDK surfaces
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
tools/validate_sdks.sh 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/sdk.log"
sha256sum sdk/java-client/build/latent-java-client.jar | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/jar.sha256"
python3 sdk/java-client/tools/java_toolchain.py classes sdk/java-client/build/latent-java-client.jar > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-sdk/jar-classfile.json"
test "$(node sdk/typescript-client/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --version)" = \
  "Version ${EXPECTED_TYPESCRIPT_VERSION}"

steps.name: Verify additive transaction client definitions and bounded Rust bridges
steps.run:
python3 tools/transaction_client_models.py --check
python3 tools/transaction_client_conversions.py --check
python3 tools/transaction_client_rust_shapes.py --check
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_transaction_client_models

reviewReason: Preserve every stateless SDK qualification and check all additive transaction definitions with pinned formatters
